tasks.label: 🚀 test locally (uninstall -> pack -> install)
tasks.command: dotnet tool uninstall --global Tools.AIBridge; dotnet pack ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Cli/AIBridge.Cli.csproj -c Release; dotnet tool install --global --add-source ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Cli/bin/Release/ Tools.AIBridge

tasks.label: 🚀 test MCP locally (uninstall -> pack -> install)
tasks.command: dotnet tool uninstall --global Tools.AIBridge.Mcp; dotnet pack ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Mcp/AIBridge.Mcp.csproj -c Release; dotnet tool install --global --add-source ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Mcp/bin/Release/ Tools.AIBridge.Mcp

tasks.label: 🏷️ release: tag & open GitHub
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep -oP '(?<=<Version>)[^<]+' ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Cli/AIBridge.Cli.csproj) && echo "📦 Version: $VERSION" && git -C ${workspaceFolder} tag "v$VERSION" && git -C ${workspaceFolder} push origin "v$VERSION" && echo "✅ Tag v$VERSION pushed." && xdg-open "https://github.com/arpanvgm/ai-bridge/releases/new?tag=v$VERSION&title=v$VERSION" 2>/dev/null || open "https://github.com/arpanvgm/ai-bridge/releases/new?tag=v$VERSION&title=v$VERSION" 2>/dev/null || echo "👉 Open this URL to create the release: https://github.com/arpanvgm/ai-bridge/releases/new?tag=v$VERSION&title=v$VERSION"

windows.command: $version = ([xml](Get-Content '${workspaceFolder}\src\AIBridge.Cli\AIBridge.Cli.csproj')).Project.PropertyGroup.Version; Write-Host "📦 Version: $version"; git -C '${workspaceFolder}' tag "v$version"; git -C '${workspaceFolder}' push origin "v$version"; Write-Host "✅ Tag v$version pushed."; Start-Process "https://github.com/arpanvgm/ai-bridge/releases/new?tag=v$version&title=v$version"
